thesis.description: Challenge a familiar assumption, qualify it, then explain a defensible alternative.
thesis.psychologicalMechanism: A credible disagreement creates curiosity when the viewer expects a common answer.
thesis.whyItMayWork: It can differentiate Vision/founder thinking without relying on artificial controversy.
whenToUse: There is a real defensible viewpoint.
The nuance can be explained within short-form constraints.
whenNotToUse: The statement is exaggerated for engagement.
The claim requires evidence that is unavailable.

hook.formula: State a defensible disagreement, immediately qualify the context, then explain and demonstrate.
originalExamples: Le problème, ce n’est pas de ne pas avoir assez de prospects. C’est souvent d’en chercher trop mal ciblés.

story.objective: Use an example or product proof.
Close with a thoughtful next step.

visual.openingVisualIntent: Pair the contrarian statement with a clear presenter or text-led opening.
visual.proofMoment: An example that makes the counter-position credible.

forbiddenMoves: Making controversial factual claims without evidence.

provenance.abstractionNotes: Initial Vision V1 seed defined during product specification.
